confidence_notes: Restaurant meal, coffee and beer anchors come from aggregator cost-of-living results (three searches in total). Those results disagree somewhat and may come from different years. Cocktail figures come from craft cocktail bars listed by World's 50 Best, so they are likely above the typical price. Wine by the glass had no reliable data. I set it from the local price relationship to beer and cocktails, with a mid-range figure between them. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Taiwan and Kaohsiung. I did not search accommodation prices and did not inspect any booking pages or listings. The FX rate is the RBA figure dated 18 Nov 2026, the latest the search returned. It is not a July 2026 rate.
comparable_city_reasoning: Kaohsiung is generally cheaper than Taipei. Its food and drink prices are close to Taichung and Tainan. Accommodation is based on typical Taiwan secondary-city hostel and budget-hotel levels.
